player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Bravo 3''') posted a [[Light]] [[Echo Base Operations]] list on DeckTech in July 2000.
description: A standard EBO deck with excellent force loss protection and a bit of retrieval to help you win by a LOT.
cards: posted: Hoth Echo Command Center (War Room)
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Qty 15 as published: the card list stops after 'Derek' (the Characters [14] section is cut off after six names, and every later section is missing); DeckTech's list appears to have been cut at the apostrophe in Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian. Nothing was added. The author posted 'Win BIG with EBO v2 0' the next day (DeckTech 8841).
Side Light (the draft said Dark): every posted card is Light, and the deck is an Echo Base Operations deck per the description and strategy; Echo Base Operations itself is not in the surviving list.

Posted 'Commander Evarm Lajaie' dested Commander Evram Lajaie; 'Derek' Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian; 'Hoth North Ridge (S)' and 'Hoth Main Power Generators (S)' the marker sites Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) and Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker); 'Hoth Echo Command Center (War Room)' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room).
